id.description: Globally unique identifier for this permission.

ifsId.description: Stable IFS entity identifier for Permission.

name.description: Human-readable or machine-readable permission name, such as ACCESS_SYSTEM_DOCUMENTS or ADMIN.

grantedBy.description: Identifier of the user, organization, group, community, or other authority source granting this permission.

draftedBy.description: Identifier of the user, organization, group, community, or other authority source drafting this permission.

grantedTo.description: Identifier of the actor receiving this permission.

scopeId.description: Identifier of the scope object where this permission applies.

scope.description: Scope object describing the system, project, process, area, or other bounded context where this permission applies.

state.description: Lifecycle state of the permission. Example values may include drafted, under-review, active, suspended, or revoked.

createdAt.description: Timestamp when this permission record was created.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp when this permission record was last updated.

expiresAt.description: Optional timestamp after which this permission no longer applies.

revokedAt.description: Optional timestamp when this permission was revoked.

revocationReason.description: Optional explanation for why this permission was revoked.

constraints.description: Optional contextual limits such as time windows, resource limits, approval requirements, or conditional checks.

delegationEvidenceIds.description: Optional identifiers for consent records, votes, delegations, signatures, or audit evidence proving the permission grant.
